# Let's fetch all pages of pending requests to ensure we have all of them.
# We'll loop until we get fewer than page_limit items.
all_pending = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=access_token, status="pending", page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    all_pending.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print("Total pending requests fetched:", len(all_pending))
# Print all with created_at to see dates
for req in all_pending:
    print(req["payment_request_id"], req["created_at"], req["amount"])
